reviews.reason: No release that typedoc accepts is patched: 9.0.9 is the newest 9.x, the fix shipped in 11.0.1, typedoc 0.28.13 requires ^9.0.5 and the newest typedoc (0.28.20) still requires a vulnerable ^10. This exact development-only archive only matches the glob patterns in the repository's own typedoc configuration when API docs are generated. All six runtime audits must remain empty; this does not authorize an exposed service or untrusted glob input. Move to a typedoc release that takes a patched minimatch before expiry.
